## ANALYSIS OF THE DIVERGENCE (results from the contour selection)

```{r}

rm(list = ls())

library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(stats)
library(ez)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(rstatix)

# Call the directory of the data file "Probier_data"

Agreement1 <- read_excel("/Users/.../Probier_data.xlsx", sheet = "Agreement1")

Agreement2 <- read_excel("/Users/.../Probier_data.xlsx", sheet = "Agreement2")
```

Proportion of different contour selection between the crit and sugg conditions

```{r}

## Analysis of 2-AFC task

# One-sample t-test
print(res_para <- t.test(Agreement1$Diff_percent, mu = 50,alternative = "greater"))
summary(Agreement1$Diff_percent)

# One-sample wilcoxon test: if you want to test whether the median selection is greater than 375 or 50: chance level (one-tailed test)
print(res_non_para <- wilcox.test(Agreement1$Diff_percent, mu = 50,alternative = "greater"))

## Analysis of 4-AFC task

# One-sample t-test
print(res_para <- t.test(Agreement2$Diff_percent, mu = 50,alternative = "greater"))
summary(Agreement2$Diff_percent)

# One-sample wilcoxon test: if you want to test whether the median selection is greater than 375 or 50: chance level (one-tailed test)
print(res_non_para <- wilcox.test(Agreement2$Diff_percent, mu = 50,alternative = "greater"))

```

Illustration of the divergence with violin plots

```{r}

# Load and standardize Agreement1
agreement1_clean <- Agreement1 %>%
  rename(Divergence = Diff_percent) %>%
  mutate(Condition = "2-AFC") %>%  # Assign condition (adjust as needed)
  select(Sub, Condition, Divergence)

# Load and standardize Agreement2
agreement2_clean <- Agreement2 %>%
  rename(Divergence = Diff_percent) %>%
  mutate(Condition = "4-AFC") %>%  # Assign condition (adjust as needed)
  select(Sub, Condition, Divergence)

# Combine vertically
combined_data <- bind_rows(agreement1_clean, agreement2_clean)

# Verify
head(combined_data)

# Plot
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  Agreement1 %>% mutate(Condition = "2-AFC"),
  Agreement2 %>% mutate(Condition = "4-AFC")
) %>%
  rename(Divergence = Diff_percent)  # Use the common column

combined_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Condition, y = Divergence)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Condition), 
              color = "black", 
              alpha = 0.7, 
              width = 0.6,  
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2-AFC" = "gray70", "4-AFC" = "gray70")) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(y = "Divergence in contour selection (%)", x = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 2, 5, 2),
    aspect.ratio = 1.5
  )

# Display plot
print(combined_plot)
```


## DESCRIPTION OF THE CONTOURS FROM THE REVERSE CORRELATION METHOD

Preparation and loading(s)

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

setwd("/Users/p.larrouy/Desktop")

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)


kernel_data <- read_excel("Probier_data.xlsx",sheet = "Kernels")

```

Create a column that every participant has a specific ID

```{r}
kernel_data$ID <- paste(kernel_data$Probier, kernel_data$participant, sep = "_")
```

Compute the average f0

```{r}
selected_columns <- c("p1", "p2", "p3", "p4", "p5")
kernel_data$Average <- rowMeans(kernel_data[selected_columns])
```

To avoid error: transformation of intention as factor and transformation of spikiness and direction as numeric.

```{r}
kernel_data$ID <- as.factor(kernel_data$ID)
kernel_data$intention <- as.factor(kernel_data$intention)
kernel_data$spikiness <- as.numeric(kernel_data$spikiness)
kernel_data$direction <- as.numeric(kernel_data$direction)
```

# Comparison of mental representation with paired-t-tests at the three levels of granularity

Discrete contours: paired t test for each of the five points

Application of the Holm-Bonferroni method for the multiple comparison correction => p_adj = p / k = 0.5 / 5 = .01


```{r}

t.test(kernel_data$p1[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$p1[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

t.test(kernel_data$p2[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$p2[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

t.test(kernel_data$p3[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$p3[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

t.test(kernel_data$p4[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$p4[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

t.test(kernel_data$p5[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$p5[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

```
mean f0: paired t test without correction for multiple comparisons

```{r}
t.test(kernel_data$Average[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$Average[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)
```

contour dimension: paired sample t test (p_adj = .025)

```{r}

t.test(kernel_data$spikiness[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$spikiness[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

t.test(kernel_data$direction[kernel_data$intention == "crit"], kernel_data$direction[kernel_data$intention == "sugg"], paired = TRUE)

```


Figure 2A: Discrete contours

```{r}

# Prepare data with explicit row IDs
connected_data <- kernel_data %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%  # Create unique IDs
  pivot_longer(p1:p5, names_to = "point", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(point = factor(point, levels = paste0("p", 1:5)))

# Create unified plot
plot_2A <- ggplot(connected_data, aes(x = point, y = value)) +
  
  # --- Individual Points ---
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = intention),
    width = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.3,
    size = 1.5,
    shape = 16,
    dodge.width = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # --- Connecting Lines ---
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(id, intention)),
    color = "gray60",
    alpha = 0.15,
    size = 0.3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  
  # --- Standard Deviation Bars (now color-matched) ---
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = intention, color = intention),  # Color by intention
    fun.data = mean_sdl,
    fun.args = list(mult = 1),
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.1,
    size = 0.6,  # Slightly thicker
    alpha = 0.8,  # Less transparent
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  
  # --- Mean Trajectories ---
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = intention, color = intention),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  
  # --- Mean Points ---
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = intention, color = intention),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +

  # --- Styling ---
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  labs(y = "Pitch values (cents)", x = "Time points") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

plot_2A
```

Figure 2B: contour dimensions

```{r}
summary_data <- kernel_data %>%
  group_by(intention) %>%  # Group by 'crit' and 'sugg'
  summarise(
    mean_spikiness = mean(spikiness, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_direction = mean(direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_spikiness = sd(spikiness, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_direction = sd(direction, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

plot_2B <- ggplot(kernel_data, aes(x = spikiness, y = direction)) +
  theme_bw() +
  
  # --- Individual Points ---
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = intention, color = intention),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  
  # --- SD Bars ---
  geom_errorbarh(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(y = mean_direction,
        xmin = mean_spikiness - sd_spikiness,
        xmax = mean_spikiness + sd_spikiness,
        color = intention),
    height = 0.05,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(x = mean_spikiness,
        ymin = mean_direction - sd_direction,
        ymax = mean_direction + sd_direction,
        color = intention),
    width = 0.05,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # --- Mean Points ---
  geom_point(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(x = mean_spikiness, y = mean_direction,
        fill = intention, color = intention),
    size = 5,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  
  # --- Reference Lines ---
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # --- Scales ---
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "direction (PC-scores)",
    limits = c(-0.6, 0.8),
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "spikiness (PC-scores)",
    limits = c(-0.5, 0.8),
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  
  # --- Square Aspect Ratio ---
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8/2) +  # (x-range/y-range) = (0.8-(-0.8))/(1-(-1)) = 1.6/2 = 0.8
  
  # --- Theme ---
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    aspect.ratio = 1  # Ensures panel remains square
  )
plot_2B
```

Figure 2C: Mean f0

```{r}
plot_2C <- ggplot(kernel_data, aes(x = intention, y = Average)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  
  # --- Individual Points (more visible) ---
  geom_point(
    aes(color = intention),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),  # Reduced jitter width
    alpha = 0.5,  # Increased visibility
    size = 3,     # Slightly larger
    shape = 16
  ) +
  
  # --- Standard Deviation Bars ---
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_sdl,
    fun.args = list(mult = 1),
    geom = "errorbar",
    aes(group = intention, color = intention),
    width = 0.2,  # Wider bars for better visibility
    size = 1,     # Thicker lines
    alpha = 1,    # Fully opaque
    lineend = "round"  # Rounded ends
  ) +
  
  # --- Mean Points (enhanced) ---
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    aes(fill = intention, color = intention),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,      # Larger mean points
    stroke = 1.5,   # Thicker outline
    show.legend = FALSE  # Avoid duplicate in legend
  ) +
  
  # --- Zero Reference Line (more subtle) ---
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linewidth = 0.3,  # Thinner line
    color = "grey60", # Lighter color
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # --- Scales and Theme ---
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "mean f0 (cents)",  # More descriptive label
    limits = c(-150, 150), 
    breaks = seq(-150, 150, 50),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 10))
  )

plot_2C
```

Combining plots and setting the label sizes

```{r}

# Increase text sizes in all plots
plot_2A <- plot_2A +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)                   
  )

plot_2B <- plot_2B +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(x = "spikiness (PC-scores)", y = "direction (PC-scores)")

plot_2C <- plot_2C +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )

# Create an impossible-to-miss legend
legend_plot <- ggplot(kernel_data, aes(x = intention, y = Average, color = intention)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +  # Massive points in legend
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8"),
    labels = c("Criticism", "Suggestion"),
    name = "Intention" 
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),                
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),                    
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm")                       
  )

shared_legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)

# Combine plots with new ratios
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(
  plot_2A + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  plot_2B + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  plot_2C + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  nrow = 1,
  widths = c(3, 4, 1)  # A=3, B=4, C=1
) / 
shared_legend +
plot_layout(
  heights = c(10, 2),  
  guides = "collect"
)

# Add large panel labels
combined_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", "C"))) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),  
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)                
  )

# Save with big dimensions
ggsave("final_plot_giant_labels.png", combined_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)  # Giant canvas

print(combined_plot)
```

Other visualisation of Figure 2A (as a back up option)

```{r}

# Prepare data
plot_data <- kernel_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(p1:p5, names_to = "point", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(point = factor(point, levels = paste0("p", 1:5)))

# Create plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = intention, y = value)) +
  # Distribution visualization
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = intention),
    width = 0.5, 
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = intention),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Mean markers
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean, 
    geom = "point", 
    shape = 21, 
    size = 3,
    fill = "white", 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Significance for p4 and p5 only (FIXED)
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("crit", "sugg")),
    test = "t.test",
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    y_position = max(plot_data$value) * 1.05,
    tip_length = 0,
    textsize = 5,
    vjust = 0.5,
    data = function(x) {filter(x, point %in% c("p4", "p5"))}  # Corrected filter syntax
  ) +
  
  # Color scheme
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#e41a1c","#377eb8")) +
  
  # Faceting and theming
  facet_wrap(~point, nrow = 1) +
  labs(y = "Value", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```
